lib/screens/pokemon/pokemon_detail_scree.È incapacitato e trattenuto e ha svantag: It is incapacitated and restrained and has disadvantage on all saving throws. It lasts three rounds. When it is forcibly moved and at the end of each of its turns, roll 1d20: on 11 or higher, the condition ends.
lib/screens/pokemon/pokemon_detail_scree.Tira due volte tutti i dadi di danno e u: Roll all damage dice twice and use the lower result. Until cured or unconscious, it takes damage equal to its proficiency bonus at the end of each turn. Fire-type Pokémon are immune.
lib/screens/pokemon/pokemon_detail_scree.Non può effettuare reazioni. Dura tre ro: It cannot take reactions. It lasts three rounds. At the start of its turn, roll 1d8 to determine its behavior; on 8, the condition ends.
lib/screens/pokemon/pokemon_detail_scree.Ha svantaggio a tutti i tiri per colpire: It has disadvantage on all attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws until the end of its next turn. It is shown for reference only and cannot be selected manually.
lib/screens/pokemon/pokemon_detail_scree.È incapacitato e trattenuto. La condizio: It is incapacitated and restrained. The condition ends if it breaks free, takes Fire-type damage or is hit by a move that can cause Burn. Ice-type Pokémon are immune.
lib/screens/pokemon/pokemon_detail_scree.Ha svantaggio ai tiri salvezza su FOR e: It has disadvantage on STR and DEX saving throws and moves at half speed. At the start of its turn, roll 1d4: on 1, it is incapacitated and restrained until the start of its next turn. Electric-type Pokémon are immune.
lib/screens/pokemon/pokemon_detail_scree.Ha svantaggio a tutte le prove di caratt: It has disadvantage on all ability checks and attack rolls. Until cured or unconscious, it takes damage equal to its proficiency bonus at the end of each turn. Poison- and Steel-type Pokémon are immune.
